coverageNotes: Tests deriving a required complete stored-document validator from a schema, including system fields. Does not assess restore logic, missing-record handling, writes, or authorization. Real backend probes use the byte-identical original schema and Convex 1.44.0 within source range ^1.44.0.

questions.question: Which option uses the schema to validate the whole document?

options.rationale: A table validator describes the declared application fields, without the stored-document system fields. It rejects genuine snapshots and accepts payloads missing both system fields.
The schema document validator adds required table-specific _id and _creationTime fields to the declared fields without repeating validator definitions.
The full-document helper belongs to SchemaDefinition, not TableDefinition. TableDefinition has no doc() method.
SchemaDefinition has no validator() method. The full-document helper is named doc(tableName).
